nodes.name: Every 1 Minute
nodes.notes: Probes all four critical services every minute. Any non-200 response (or timeout) immediately alerts the on-call engineer.

nodes.name: Probe n8n
nodes.notes: n8n's own /healthz endpoint. Returns 200 OK when the instance is ready to serve requests.

nodes.name: Probe Backend API
nodes.notes: FastAPI backend liveness probe. Returns 200 + JSON { status: 'ok', db: true, redis: true } when all subsystems are healthy.

nodes.name: Probe Database
nodes.notes: Backend endpoint that runs SELECT 1 against PostgreSQL. Returns 200 + { ok: true, latency_ms: <n> }.

nodes.name: Probe Redis
nodes.notes: Backend endpoint that runs PING against Redis. Returns 200 + { ok: true, latency_ms: <n> }.

nodes.name: Alert Slack (Health)
nodes.notes: Immediate Slack alert to #ops-alerts whenever any probe fails.

nodes.name: Page On-Call
nodes.notes: Pages the on-call engineer immediately. Dedup key groups repeated failures from the same services into a single incident.

nodes.name: Push Health Gauge
nodes.notes: Always pushes (healthy or not) so Grafana has a continuous health line.

meta.description: Probes n8n (/healthz), backend API (/api/health), database (/api/health/db), and Redis (/api/health/redis) every minute. Any failure immediately alerts #ops-alerts on Slack, pages the on-call engineer via PagerDuty, and logs to the audit table. Pushes a health gauge to Prometheus on every run regardless of outcome.
